governance: Master Execution Framework Amendment v1.2 / Rule IV-001 Non-Self-Acceptance

blockers.summary: Check 04, Check 06, and Check 08 failed due to gate verification expression defects rather than database non-conformance.
blockers.root_cause: Check 04 matched brittle formatting rather than semantic patterns. Check 06 matched text 'NOT ILIKE' while PostgreSQL pg_get_constraintdef deparses to '!~~*'. Check 08 compared regclass::text string without schema qualification ('organization_aliases' instead of 'public.organization_aliases') and relied on brittle array joins.
blockers.resolution: Check 04 refactored with format-resilient regex; Check 06 refactored to handle PostgreSQL deparsing (!~~* and array containment); Check 08 rewritten to inspect pg_constraint.confdeltype directly and join pg_class with pg_namespace.

blockers.summary: Check 05 (RLS) and Check 06 (tenures) utilized CROSS JOIN between CTEs, risking row multiplication and misleading aggregate outputs.
blockers.root_cause: CROSS JOIN check_5_rls r CROSS JOIN check_5_policies p and CROSS JOIN check_6_uq u CROSS JOIN check_6_status_col s CROSS JOIN check_6_jt_cc j.
blockers.resolution: Refactored Checks 5 and 6 into guaranteed single-row scalar metric subqueries without cartesian joins. Updated hash in test and dossier.

blockers.summary: Discrepancy between 4,123 statutory Assembly Constituencies and 4,142 reported in demographics manifest.
blockers.root_cause: Mathematical reconciliation across all 36 jurisdictions reveals Gross Surplus = +153 (Delhi +151, Himachal Pradesh +2) and Gross Deficit = -134 (12 states with missing trailing ACs: AS -14, BR -16, CG -9, GA -6, GJ -13, HR -10, JH -8, MP -22, OD -15, PB -6, RJ -13, UP -2). Net Delta = +153 - 134 = +19. Manifest was compiled from incomplete/untruncated regional seed arrays.
blockers.resolution: Complete 36-jurisdiction mathematical reconciliation matrix established. Canonical universe reaffirmed as 4,123 current ACs and 543 PCs under Delimitation Order 2008 / AP 2014 / J&K 2022. Demographics pipeline re-anchoring specified.

blockers.summary: Demographics table lacked foreign key relationship to canonical constituency registry, allowing orphaned demographic records.
blockers.root_cause: Table public.constituency_demographics relied solely on (state_code, ac_no, election_year) without FK to public.constituencies(id). Note that public.constituencies uses TEXT primary key (e.g., 'TS-AC-1') and UNIQUE (state_code, ac_no).
blockers.resolution: Architecture specified: constituency_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.constituencies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, accompanied by composite FK REFERENCES public.constituencies(state_code, ac_no) to enforce dual alignment.

blockers.summary: Population reports claimed 'Actual Database Inserts' (1,207 for C, 48,284 for D, 8,869 for E) but scripts used in-memory JavaScript Maps with zero database connections.
blockers.root_cause: Builder scripts instantiated in-memory mock storage and wrote JSON reports claiming database insertion without executing any SQL against staging Supabase.
blockers.resolution: Reports reclassified honestly as SIMULATED / IN-MEMORY ONLY. Staging execution marked UNPOPULATED. Real transactional SQL population architecture designed.

blockers.summary: Migration 065 line 138 contains ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET, creating silent mutation/overwrite risk for existing canonical data.
blockers.root_cause: Permissive upsert logic silently updates canonical organizations instead of failing closed or executing DO NOTHING.
blockers.resolution: Hardened 065 specification: replace ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE with exact identity verification / ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING with fail-closed conflict validation.

blockers.summary: Premature claims of milestone completion prior to actual staging execution and gate verification.
blockers.root_cause: Conflation of local unit test passing with staging deployment and verification acceptance.
blockers.resolution: Formal status held at OPEN / AWAITING CTO REVIEW. Zero production access. Zero unapproved staging executions.
